prereqs: Blender 3.6+ open with the MCP for Blender add-on enabled and connected. uv installed via the official installer. DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true turns off even the anonymous usage record. Premium AI model generation (Hunyuan3D, Tripo, Hyper3D) is optional and paid; Poly Haven assets are free CC0.
claude_code_command: claude mcp add blender --env DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true -- uvx mcp-for-blender
note: Placeholders only. Never commit real keys; keep secrets in .env or the OS keychain.
